name: url
label: URL
help: The page to check, for example `https://example.com`. `https://` is added when no scheme is given.

name: cwv
label: Measure Core Web Vitals
help: Adds measured Core Web Vitals. Adds about 10 seconds the first time a URL is measured. Never changes the score.

name: include
label: Extras
help: Paid plans. Each adds a few seconds and uses no extra audit.
